weaker_than_regulation.label: Board re-approval of material facilities
weaker_than_regulation.quote: Material facilities shall be re-approved by the Board of Directors at least every five years.
weaker_than_regulation.regulation_quote: Material Credit Facilities must be approved by the Board at least every three years.
weaker_than_regulation.says: material facilities approved by the Board at least every three years
weaker_than_regulation.message: Policy 2.2 allows 5 years; CBUAE CRM Art. 2.6 requires 3 years: the stricter (the regulation) applies and the policy should be amended.

weaker_than_regulation.label: Stage 3 collateral valuation age
weaker_than_regulation.quote: at least every 18 months for obligors in Stage 3.
weaker_than_regulation.regulation_quote: For Stage 3 Facilities, this valuation must have been performed within the last 12 months of the reporting date.
weaker_than_regulation.says: Stage 3 real estate valued within the last 12 months
weaker_than_regulation.message: Policy 7.3 allows 18 months; CBUAE CRM Art. 10.11 requires 12 months: the stricter (the regulation) applies and the policy should be amended.

weaker_than_regulation.label: Review frequency
weaker_than_regulation.quote: Every corporate obligor shall be reviewed at least every 18 months.
weaker_than_regulation.regulation_quote: The CCO is required to review Obligors and associated exposures every year.
weaker_than_regulation.says: every wholesale obligor reviewed, and its rating updated, every year
weaker_than_regulation.message: Policy 8.1 allows 18 months; CBUAE CRM Art. 4.3 requires 12 months: the stricter (the regulation) applies and the policy should be amended.

weaker_than_regulation.label: Days past due to Stage 2
weaker_than_regulation.quote: A facility more than 60 days past due shall be classified in Stage 2 and placed on the watchlist.
weaker_than_regulation.regulation_quote: Credit Facilities with Repayments more than 30 Days-Past-Due must be identified as deteriorating assets and therefore subject to SICR.
weaker_than_regulation.says: more than 30 days past due is a SICR (Stage 2)
weaker_than_regulation.message: Policy 8.3 allows 60 days; CBUAE CRM Art. 7.8 requires 30 days: the stricter (the regulation) applies and the policy should be amended.

weaker_than_regulation.label: Moratorium to Stage 2
weaker_than_regulation.quote: A non-distressed restructuring with a repayment moratorium exceeding 9 months shall be classified in Stage 2.
weaker_than_regulation.regulation_quote: All non-distressed Restructured Credit Facilities with a Repayment moratorium exceeding 6 months must be classified as Stage 2
weaker_than_regulation.says: non-distressed restructuring with a moratorium over 6 months: Stage 2
weaker_than_regulation.message: Policy 8.6 allows 9 months; CBUAE CRM Art. 9.31 requires 6 months: the stricter (the regulation) applies and the policy should be amended.

weaker_than_regulation.label: Stage 3 write-off period
weaker_than_regulation.quote: Stage 3 exposures shall be written off no later than 7 years after classification in Stage 3.
weaker_than_regulation.regulation_quote: The LFI must not hold a Stage 3 exposure on the balance sheet for more than 5 years since the date of migration to Stage 3.
weaker_than_regulation.says: no Stage 3 exposure held more than 5 years after migration
weaker_than_regulation.message: Policy 8.7 allows 7 years; CBUAE CRM Art. 12.5 requires 5 years: the stricter (the regulation) applies and the policy should be amended.

consistent_with_regulation.label: Material facility threshold (share of Tier 1)
consistent_with_regulation.quote: Facilities to a single obligor or group exceeding 10% of the Bank's Tier 1 capital are material facilities and require the approval of the Board of Directors.
consistent_with_regulation.regulation_quote: Any Facility leading to an exposure greater than 10% of the LFI’s Tier 1 Capital
consistent_with_regulation.says: material facilities include any exposure above 10% of Tier 1 capital
consistent_with_regulation.message: Policy 2.1 (10 %) is at least as strict as CBUAE CRM Art. 2.6 (10 %).

consistent_with_regulation.label: Review frequency (B+ or worse)
consistent_with_regulation.quote: obligors rated B+ or worse at least every 12 months.
consistent_with_regulation.regulation_quote: The rating of all Credit Facilities and Obligors must be reviewed at least on a yearly cycle.
consistent_with_regulation.says: ratings of all facilities and obligors reviewed at least yearly
consistent_with_regulation.message: Policy 8.1 (12 months) is at least as strict as CBUAE CRM Art. 11.3 (12 months).

consistent_with_regulation.label: Days past due to Stage 3
consistent_with_regulation.quote: A facility more than 90 days past due on a material obligation shall be classified in Stage 3.
consistent_with_regulation.regulation_quote: The Obligor is Past Due for a period greater than 90 days on any material credit obligation to the LFI.
consistent_with_regulation.says: more than 90 days past due on a material obligation is default (Stage 3)
consistent_with_regulation.message: Policy 8.4 (90 days) is at least as strict as CBUAE CRM Art. 6.4 (90 days).

consistent_with_regulation.label: Restructurings to Stage 3
consistent_with_regulation.quote: A facility restructured three or more times in a context of financial difficulty shall be classified in Stage 3.
consistent_with_regulation.regulation_quote: Any Credit Facility that has been restructured 3 times or more in a context of financial difficulty
consistent_with_regulation.says: restructured 3 or more times in financial difficulty: Stage 3
consistent_with_regulation.message: Policy 8.5 (3 times) is at least as strict as CBUAE CRM Art. 9.29 (3 times).
